title: Manyhands JSON v1 pull-request closure preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of ticket close in a pull-request repository, or of ticket withdraw-closure in either mode: the branch record it would run, whose action is close, new_branch or withdraw. Nothing of it reaches primary: it synchronizes the ticket's branch, records or removes a closure on it, publishes it, and gives the link a pull request is opened by. It holds names, commits and paths, and no title, body or content. A prepare contacts no remote. The confirmation binds what the domain's expectation binds: a change to any of it before the request is accepted is external_change. A withdraw's preview shows closure.recording existing, the closure it would remove, with pull_request null; action tells the three apart.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

type.description: The tag that tells these details from a direct close's.

root.description: The repository's root, as the request's records name it.

action.description: close records or keeps a closure on the ticket's branch; new_branch makes the branch again from primary after its old one was deleted on the remote, keeping a provisional closure; withdraw removes a closure from the branch.

slug.description: The ticket's short code, when the index holds one.

branch.description: The ticket's editing branch, as its short name.

remote.description: The publication remote, by its name.

context_oid.description: The editing branch's head. Null for a new branch of a ticket with no context; for one with a context, its old tip.

tracking_primary_oid.description: The remote's primary, as this clone last fetched it.

closure.description: What the closure is: record is a closure this operation writes, and existing one the branch already holds, which a withdraw would remove. closed_by is the configured identity, or the value the ticket already holds.

retired_context.description: What a new branch retires of the old context: its old tip, or the remote history's last published commit. Null for any other record, and for a new branch with nothing to retire.

unheld.description: For a new branch, each path the old context holds that the primary does not, relative to the repository with forward slashes.

pull_request.description: Where to open the pull request. Null for a withdraw.
